Q3Where do grants and new business formation create a timely opportunity?

Each dot is one state in one industry. Height: new businesses in FY2025 as a share of businesses at the start. Size: state grant programs that pass the tech-adoption test (same for all three industries until the industry-reach table arrives). Filled dot: at least one is open now. Dotted ring: small cell, treat with care.

Grants show program availability only. The data holds no spend, so we cannot say where money went. Federal programs apply in every state and are left out of the counts. ACT shows zero qualifying programs by definition: it lists three that fail the tech-adoption test. Industry-level reach arrives in pass 2, so the dot size repeats across industries for now.
